# Set & Shoot — Belin Akguel Photography

> Professional volleyball and sports photography based in Bremen, Germany. Specialized in indoor volleyball, beach volleyball, tournament coverage, athlete portraits, and editorial sports storytelling across Europe.

## About
Belin Akguel is a specialized sports photographer focusing on dynamic, high-speed volleyball photography, match-day coverage, club media days, and commercial athlete portraits.

## Services & Scope
- **Match & Tournament Coverage:** High-speed action photography for national leagues, international tournaments, and club championships.
- **Club & Team Media Days:** Professional team rosters, dynamic player portraits, and promotional sponsor assets.
- **Athlete Portfolios:** Individual visual branding, personal sponsor packages, and editorial lifestyle portraits for athletes.
- **Stories & Editorial:** In-depth visual features on volleyball culture, athlete preparation, and tournament milestones.

## Primary Surfaces
- [Portfolio & Stories](https://setandshoot.com/stories): Featured tournament galleries and athlete visual stories.
- [Athletes](https://setandshoot.com/athletes): Featured professional athlete profiles and collaborations.
- [About](https://setandshoot.com/about): Philosophy, equipment, and background of Belin Akguel.
- [Services](https://setandshoot.com/services): Match coverage packages, commercial licensing, and booking inquiry.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://setandshoot.com/contact): Booking requests, tournament credentials, and licensing inquiries.

## Contact & Location
- Location: Bremen, Germany (available across Germany and Europe)
